T00.name: Generalisation to unseen field sessions + unseen units
T00.criterion: chamber+field model macro-F1 >= 0.85 on held-out field data
T00.summary: Chamber+field model: macro-F1 0.85, coverage 83%, selective accuracy 98%. Chamber-only model: macro-F1 0.68, selective accuracy 76%. int8 quantisation cost +0.3 pts accuracy.

T01.name: Chamber tests, single sources (in-distribution)
T01.summary: macro-F1 0.90, coverage 84%, selective accuracy 99% over 2201 windows on the 10 unseen pilot units.

T02.name: Detection limit (excess PM2.5 over a 30 ug/m3 background)
T02.criterion: >= 80 % correct attribution at <= 50 ug/m3 excess for every class
T02.summary: Smallest excess PM2.5 (ug/m3) attributed correctly >= 80 % of the time: biomass burning 50, dust 25, industrial 50, vehicle exhaust 100.

T03.name: Humidity sweep 20-97 % RH (incl. fog)
T03.criterion: accuracy drop at 85 % RH <= 10 pts vs 40-60 % RH; false source alarms in fog <= 10 %
T03.summary: Accuracy by RH: 20% 94%, 40% 97%, 60% 95%, 75% 93%, 85% 83%, 92% 87%, 97% 76%. Drop at 85 % RH: 13 pts. Fog (RH>=92 %, no source): 0% of windows falsely blamed on a source.

T04.name: Temperature sweep 5-45 C
T04.summary: Accuracy by temperature: 5 C 95%, 15 C 92%, 25 C 95%, 35 C 93%, 45 C 89% (spread 6 pts).

T05.name: Wind speed x direction x inlet design (PolSo-19 enclosures)
T05.criterion: hooded design: accuracy drop at 4 m/s <= 5 pts vs calm
T05.summary: Accuracy at 0.3 / 2 / 4 / 6 m/s - baseline: 93% / 96% / 91% / 88%; hooded: 94% / 93% / 94% / 88%; multi_hole: 96% / 92% / 90% / 89%. PM10 bias at 4 m/s for dust (0/90/180 deg): baseline -3%/-9%/-18%; hooded -1%/-2%/-4%; multi_hole -9%/-8%/-9%. Model trained on hooded-enclosure data only.

T06.name: Mixed sources (50/50 and 75/25 pairs)
T06.criterion: answered label is a real contributor >= 85 %; dominant source found >= 70 % at 75/25
T06.summary: Answered labels naming a real contributor: 100%. Abstained on 40% of mixed windows. Dominant source correctly named at 75/25: 71%.

T07.name: Response time to a new source
T07.criterion: median time-to-correct-label <= 90 s and <= 10 % never detected
T07.summary: Median 149 s, 90th percentile 230 s from source onset to first correct label (60 s window, 30 s hop, EMA smoothing); 2% never detected.

T08.name: Sensor ageing / drift 0-365 days
T08.criterion: macro-F1 drop at 180 days <= 10 pts with on-device baseline tracking
T08.summary: macro-F1 with baseline tracking: day 0 0.81, day 30 0.82, day 90 0.82, day 180 0.82, day 365 0.80. With frozen factory baseline: day 0 0.83, day 30 0.82, day 90 0.80, day 180 0.74, day 365 0.63.

T09.name: Unit-to-unit variation (10 pilot prototypes)
T09.criterion: std of macro-F1 across units <= 0.05 and worst unit >= 0.80
T09.summary: macro-F1 mean 0.88, std 0.023, worst unit 0.83, best 0.91 (same scenarios replayed on every unit).

T10.name: Unseen source subtypes and confounders
T10.criterion: confident-wrong <= 25 % on unseen subtypes and <= 30 % on confounders (cooking, incense); fog <= 10 %
T10.summary: cooking: correct 0% / uncertain 16% / wrong 84%; dust_storm: correct 83% / uncertain 12% / wrong 5%; fog: correct 100% / uncertain 0% / wrong 0%; incense: correct 0% / uncertain 45% / wrong 55%; trash_burning: correct 22% / uncertain 52% / wrong 26%; two_stroke_traffic: correct 28% / uncertain 56% / wrong 16%.

T11.name: 24-hour field days in six environments
T11.summary: All days: selective accuracy 89%, coverage 75%, macro-F1 0.77. Construction site, pre-monsoon summer: 99% @ 94%; Highway toll plaza: 45% @ 54%; Industrial estate: 100% @ 72%; Residential park, monsoon: 100% @ 89%; Rural village, crop-burning season: 100% @ 88%; Urban roadside, winter (Delhi-like): 58% @ 51%.

T12.name: Fault injection (UART, sensor death, fan stall, I2C, SD card)
T12.criterion: no crashes; dead sensors flagged >= 95 %; 0.1 % UART errors cost <= 3 pts; stalled-fan windows not reported as a confident source (<= 5 %)
T12.summary: none: acc 92%, flagged-after 0%, confident-after 79%; uart_bit_errors_0.1%: acc 93%, flagged-after 0%, confident-after 79%; uart_bit_errors_1%+slips: acc 100%, flagged-after 92%, confident-after 8%; pms_frames_dropped_30%: acc 100%, flagged-after 92%, confident-after 7%; pms_dead_after_1h: acc 99%, flagged-after 100%, confident-after 0%; pms_fan_stall_after_1h: acc 93%, flagged-after 0%, confident-after 100%; bme_i2c_errors_40%: acc 100%, flagged-after 96%, confident-after 4%; bme_dead_after_1h: acc 99%, flagged-after 100%, confident-after 0%; sd_write_fail_20%: acc 92%, flagged-after 0%, confident-after 79%. No crashes.

T13.name: Firmware C vs Python twin (software-in-the-loop)
T13.criterion: label agreement >= 99.5 %, max probability diff <= 0.01, RAM <= 32 KB, inference <= 10 ms
T13.summary: Labels agree on 100.00% of 537 windows (incl. a stream with UART corruption and I2C errors); max probability difference 1.1e-07; max relative feature difference 1.8e-03. Firmware state 3.1 KB RAM, model 1.8 KB flash, 1392 MACs per inference, est. ~0.18 ms per window at 170 MHz (measure with the DWT cycle counter on the board). Builds with -Wall -Wextra and no warnings.

T14.name: Battery life (2000 mAh Li-ion) and duty cycling
T14.criterion: >= 24 h continuous sampling in the configuration as specified (NUCLEO + 2000 mAh)
T14.summary: NUCLEO board, continuous: 7.3 h (232 mA avg); Custom PCB, continuous: 11.0 h (154 mA avg); Custom PCB, PMS 90 s on / 90 s off: 18.2 h (93 mA avg); Custom PCB, PMS 90 s on / 270 s off: 27.2 h (63 mA avg). Duty cycling keeps selective accuracy at 85% (1/2 duty) and 85% (1/4 duty) but only samples 33% / 17% of the time, so short events are missed.

T15.name: Research question: PM-only vs gas-only vs fused
T15.summary: macro-F1 (no abstention) on all held-out field windows: PM-only 0.76, gas-only 0.60, fused MLP 0.84 (+0.09), fused random forest 0.95.
